content: React Router v8 (GA 2026-06-17) raises baselines to Node 22.22+, React 19.2.7+, Vite 7+, drops CJS (ESM-only), and removes the react-router-dom package entirely (use react-router / react-router/dom). This is a recent major-version shift not yet reflected in STACK.md (researched 2026-07-12, 3 days prior). Registry confirms current npm dist-tags: react-router-dom frozen at 7.18.1 (latest tag), react-router latest is 8.2.0 with a version-7 dist-tag pinned at 7.18.1. No known Vite-8/React-19.2.7 incompatibilities found for the 7.x line in Data/Library mode (non-SSR).
